item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 30/Sep/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Tropical Cyclone Krathon will move across the Luzon Strait and enter the northeastern part of the South China Sea, then gradually track northwards tomorrow. It will make landfall over the southern part of Taiwan on Wednesday, then move across Taiwan towards the vicinity of the East China Sea. Under the influence of its outer subsiding air, it will still be very hot during the day over Guangdong. A strong northeast monsoon is expected to reach the coast of Guangdong tomorrow. The weather will be generally fine and dry over the region in the middle and latter parts of this week. It will be slightly cooler in the morning and at night. The temperature difference between day and night will be relatively large. A replenishment of the northeast monsoon is expected to affect southern China early next week. Meanwhile, a broad trough of low pressure will bring showers to the central and southern parts of the South China Sea.
